in_hebrew.long_meaning: Greiner הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Greiner is of German origin and is composed of two elements: 'grein' meaning power or strength, and '-er' meaning one who has or possesses. Thus, Greiner can be translated as 'the powerful one' or 'the strong one'.
